title: Enter a doctor's availability
summary: Defines which days and hours each doctor sees patients. The calendar only offers gaps within their availability and the branch's hours.

steps.title: Doctor
steps.details: The rule only applies to this doctor.

steps.title: How often it repeats
steps.details: Weekly repeats every week; biweekly, every other week; monthly, on fixed days of the month.
steps.description: The usual is weekly. Biweekly is for someone who works every other week.

steps.title: Days they see patients
steps.details: Days they see patients with these same hours. For different hours depending on the day, create another rule.

steps.title: From
steps.details: The calendar only offers appointments within these hours and the branch's hours.

steps.title: Until
steps.details: Until what time they see patients. Vacations or leave are entered separately as exceptions.

steps.title: Create the rule
steps.details: Creates the rule. From then on free gaps show up to book with them.
